en.headline: EMSD finds 720 Tai Zoom lifts missing door-frame parts
en.dek: Director Pang Kwok-ying said about 90 per cent of the contractor’s installations lacked required components; remedial work on two estates is due mid-month and private buildings within two to three months.
body: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has completed inspections of all lifts installed by Tai Zoom Elevator and found that 720 of them, covering two Tenants Purchase Scheme estates with 11 blocks and 338 private buildings, were missing required door-frame components.

Director Pang Kwok-ying told reporters after a meeting of the Lift and Escalator Safety Advisory Committee that the figure represented about 90 per cent of Tai Zoom’s installations. Spot checks of about 900 lifts by other contractors across 480 buildings had found no similar problems.

Preliminary evidence suggested serious negligence and improper conduct by the contractor, the department said. Police have been notified of suspected fraud and false statements and are investigating. The overall fire-safety level was assessed as not lower than before because the new door panels met higher standards, but the absence of the components remains unlawful.

Tai Zoom has been ordered to carry out repairs at its own expense under departmental supervision. Work on the two estates is required by mid-November, with the remaining private buildings expected to be completed within two to three months. The department is reviewing its inspection and approval processes and will expand checks to include fire-resistance components.

zh.headline: 機電署發現臺日720部升降機未裝門框組件
zh.dek: 潘國英指佔該公司安裝總數約九成；兩個租置屋邨執修要求本月中完成，私樓預計兩至三個月內完成。
body: 機電工程署已完成巡查全港由臺日電梯安裝的升降機，發現合共720部未按法例安裝門框組件，涉及兩個租者置其屋計劃屋邨共11幢樓宇及另外338幢私人樓宇。
署方署長潘國英在升降機及自動梯安全諮詢委員會會議後表示，該數字約佔臺日安裝升降機總數的九成。截至昨日，其他註冊承辦商安裝的約900部升降機（涉及480幢樓宇）抽檢均未發現同類問題。
初步證據顯示臺日涉嫌嚴重疏忽及行為不當，署方已報案，警方正就懷疑欺詐及虛假陳述展開刑事調查。消防顧問評估指新門板耐火效能較高，整體消防安全水平不會較之前為低，但未安裝組件仍屬違法。
署方已指令臺日自費並在監督下進行執修。兩個租置屋邨要求本月中完成，其餘私樓預計兩至三個月內陸續完成。署方正全面檢討審批及巡查機制，並會加強對耐火裝置的抽驗。
